text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Has she proven her strength?! In first
place, it's
Vodkaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-wowee! That three-way standoff was
absolute
fire!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy I was here to witness this! I
have a
feeling we just saw something
really special...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I did it! I won, I won, I WON!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I WON!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations. You were cool today.
Cooler
than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...But I can't claim it doesn't hurt.
That's
why I'd
like to say... let's do it again
sometime!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: All three of us.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Heh-heh. Never thought you'd be the
one to
suggest that.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm down! Come take your best shot! Vodka, the ultimate racer, is waitin' for ya!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Perfect. Because I'll still be Machan,
star
of the
show.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll see you again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd showers Aston Machan in
applause as she walks toward the
runner's tunnel. As if
enraptured by it,
she looks up at the stands.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You were so close, Machan. You were
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I never thought I'd see another
three-way
standoff like that! Thank you
so much!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: This beautiful sound. This beautiful view.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's always loveliest when those two are
around.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've truly been blessed, with both
friends... and
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Thank you both.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Let's all do it again sometime.
Someplace.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It'll definitely be another great race
next
time.
